Check the Sun Peaks weather forecast with current real-time conditions, including temperature, wind speeds and air quality updates to plan your day accurately.

Our 65th winter season begins this Thursday!

Join us on Thursday, November 26, as we kick off our winter season! Find out which lifts and terrain will be open, hours of operation, discounted lift ticket rates and details on our season opener celebration at Masa’s Bar + Grill, featuring Teton Gravity Research’s (TGR) film premiere of Actually, It Is Rocket Science.

5-Day Forecast

Today: Cloudy. A few flurries. Amounts 1 to 3 cm. Winds east to southeast 10 to 20 km/h with gusts to 30 in the alpine. High near minus 5°C (near minus 1°C in the village).

Tonight: Mainly cloudy. Chance of a flurry. Winds southeast 10 to 20 km/h with gusts to 35 in the alpine. Temperatures rising to near minus 2°C by morning (near plus 1°C in the village).

Wednesday: Mainly cloudy. Chance of a flurry. Winds southeast 10 to 20 km/h with gusts to 40 in the alpine. High near minus 1°C (near plus 3°C in the village).

Synopsis

A strong low-pressure system moving north off the BC coast will spread cloud and bands of light snow across the area today. Snowfall amounts of 1 to 3 cm are expected, mainly during the morning hours. Tonight and Wednesday, a strengthening southwesterly flow aloft will bring milder temperatures and limit precipitation to just a chance of a brief flurry or two. Winds will be generally light to moderate southeasterly with some gustiness in the alpine. Temperatures will climb slowly through the period.

Extended Outlook

Thursday to Saturday: Another disturbance is forecast to move into the southern interior from the coast late Wednesday into Thursday morning, bringing the possibility of a few more cms of snow to the upper slopes. A break in precipitation with partly cloudy skies and cooler temperatures is expected on Friday and Saturday as a weak ridge of high pressure builds over the southern interior.

Weather & Conditions FAQS

Q: Is this the Sun Peaks weather forecast?

A: Yes. This page provides the Sun Peaks weather forecast, using on-site observations and resort-specific forecasting rather than data from nearby communities.

Q: How accurate is the Sun Peaks weather report?

A: Conditions are measured directly on the mountain using resort weather stations, providing highly accurate, location-specific data including temperature, wind and air quality.

Q: Does Sun Peaks have its own snow report?

A: Yes. During the winter season, snowfall totals and snow conditions are tracked on the mountain and updated regularly.

Q: What is the Air Quality Health Index (AQHI)?

A: The Air Quality Health Index (AQHI) measures the health risks associated with local air quality on a scale from 1 to 10+, with higher values indicating greater health risks. For the latest health recommendations, visit the Government of Canada’s Air Quality Health Index. Guests should consider their individual health circumstances when planning outdoor activities.
